verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de is a hosted notarization, incorporation and translation service reached through its own cloud API and portal. Self-hosting is a fair openness question for a SaaS product, but nothing in the evidence mentions a self-hostable, on-premise or open-source deployment of the core product. All evidence points to hosted endpoints such as api.beglaubigt.de and a hosted dashboard.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
